description_text:
All hail from the dusty deserts!
This is our Dieselpunk inspired War Vehicle.
This Dieselpunk War Vehicle is heavily inspired by the Dieselpunk art. 
Creating this asset took a little while as I wanted it to have as much detail as possible while keeping polygon and vertex count relatively reasonable. Overall, vehicle itself has 231K's of polygon.
It has 17 set of textures. Each for a spesific part of the War Vehicle. Each set is in 2K.
Dieselpunk War Vehicle is %100 game ready and ready to use in Unity URP, HDRP and Standard shader pipelines, as well as UE4.
All texture sets contains:
-Base Color -Metallic -Roughness -Normal -Height -Ambient Occlusion -Emission and Opacity if there is
Thanks in advance.

description_text:
Make sure to use Zbrush 2021.6.5 or later.
40  High poly sculpts
Super timesaver  - quickly spice up 3D sculpting/designing/concepting, and a great accompaniment to Wings. 
Included you will find:

  - 14 primary feathers

  - 10 secondary feathers

  - 6 covert feathers

  - 5 dirty feathers

  - 5  stone feathers

  - 3 x Zbrush IMM  housing all 40 feathers (IInsertMultiMesh .ZBP), with _HIGH being quite high polycount for each considering their size on creatures, _MEDIUM being the same 40 feathers but at a fairly lower polycount, and then _LOW for really low polycount verions. 

  - Zbrush master file  with all the feathers as separate subtools (.ZTL)

  - single FBX file with all the meshes laid out 

  - separate OBJ for each mesh

These are untextured high poly sculpts. 
All have been decimated as much as possible without sacrificing detail.

description_text:
Renderelésre kész !Mission: Design“The designers’ dream is for the Mission E to acquire a status similar to that of the 911.” (Michael Mauer, Porsche design head)
Thrillingly different yet reassuringly familiar—that is precisely what the car should look like. Every inch and every radius should trigger the feeling and the thought that “this can only be a Porsche.” The sculpted lines of a sports sedan with a low-slung 51.1-inch roofline combined with the qualities of a sports car from Zuffenhausen.
And then there are the evident innovations such as the integrated aerodynamics. Distinctive air intakes and outlets on the front, sides, and rear showcase the body’s comprehensive flow-through design. After all, even an electric car needs intelligent cooling for its motors, battery, and electronics. Integrated channels enhance the air flow around its wheels, while outlets on the sides play their part in helping to reduce excess pressure in the wheel arches and thus the risk of lift. Once again, form follows function—a principle with a long tradition at Porsche.
The classic elements of the Mission E clearly evoke its iconic heritage. The arrow-like front is reminiscent of the 918 Spyder, interwoven with the lines of famous race cars. Distinctive front fenders and extremely flat hood lines and side windows show the genes shared with the 911. As on the 911 GT3 RS, a pronounced, broad recess runs from the overlapping front hood up and over the roof. In a word—familiarity.
And now for the thrilling part. Innovative matrix LED headlights with the brand’s characteristic four-point design hover within the air intakes. The four points surround a flat sensor used for driver assistance systems, with a border that serves as a turn signal. The flow of surfaces is not disturbed by side mirrors; instead, cameras are mounted discreetly on the sides. The future beckons. Even the handles on the rear-hinged doors are seamlessly integrated into the outer shell. A continuous arc of red light connects the broad rear fenders, with a back-lit Porsche insignia located below it in black glass.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

The Porsche 918 Spyder is a limited-production mid-engine plug-in hybrid hypercar manufactured by German automobile manufacturer Porsche.[4] The 918 Spyder is powered by a naturally aspirated 4.6 L (4,593 cc) V8 engine, developing 447 kW (608 PS; 599 hp) at 8,700 RPM, with two electric motors delivering an additional 210 kW (286 PS; 282 hp) for a combined output of 652 kW (875 hp) and 1,280 N⋅m (944 lbf⋅ft) of torque.[5][6] The 918 Spyder's 6.8 kWh lithium-ion battery pack delivers an all-electric range of 19 km (12 mi) under the US Environmental Protection Agency's five-cycle tests.
Production began on 18 September 2013, with deliveries initially scheduled to begin in December 2013, and a starting price of ≈€711,000 (US$845,000 or GB£711,000). The 918 Spyder was sold out in December 2014 and production ended in June 2015.
The 918 Spyder was first shown as a concept at the 80th Geneva Motor Show in March 2010. On 28 July 2010, after 2,000 declarations of interest, the supervisory board of Porsche AG approved series development of the 918 Spyder.The production version was unveiled at the September 2013 Frankfurt Motor Show. Porsche also unveiled the RSR racing variant of the 918 at the 2011 North American International Auto Show, which combines hybrid technology first used in the 997 GT3 R Hybrid, with styling from the 918 Spyder. However, the 918 RSR didn't make it to production. The 918 Spyder was the second plug-in hybrid car manufactured by Porsche, after the 2014 Panamera S E-Hybrid.

description_text:
About White-Laffly AMD 80:
Armored car (1933-34)France - 28 built
DesignThe AMD 80 was characterized by a long wheelbase, and only the rear axle had off-road tires. Its off-road performance, in European conditions, was not amazing, but the vehicle could climb a 40° slope, and cruise at about 80 km/h (50 mph) on the North African roads. The bodywork was conventional, made of 8 mm (0.31 in) plates bolted together to a central frame, with the driving compartment forward and the fighting compartment just behind, with an one-man asymmetric turret housing a 13.2 mm (0.52 in) heavy machine gun, a 7.5 mm (0.29 in) coaxial FM24/29 Fortress type machine gun, and another one at the rear of the turret, firing backwards. There was a small one-piece hatch on top of the turret. Access was granted by two side doors. The driver had sight slits and armoured shutters, and a second one was provided for driving in reverse. Indeed, there were a front & rear driving positions and four gears for each sense, but steering was only applied to the front axle, which required skill to drive backwards at full speed. External storage was provided on the two steps and rear muguards. 28 vehicles were converted in all.
ActionThe Laffly AMD 80 was used initially in the 6th and 8th Regiments of Cuirassiers. In 1937, this model was replaced by Panhard AMD 178 in these units, and the 27 vehicles still in service were sent to French North Africa, joining the 1st Foreign Cavalry Regiment and the 4th Regiment of Chasseurs d\'Afrique. After the 1940 armistice, they were transferred to the 8th Regiment of Chasseurs d'Afrique, but many returned to the 4th Regiment of Chasseurs d'Afrique for a parade in May 1943, marking the victory and the end of the desert war.

description_text:
This 3D model was built by the strict quality standards of the team founded by Frezzy.Since 2013, we have provided thousands of 3D models for professional projects of our clients around the world.We create 3D models so that our customers save maximum their costs and time.
FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS:

  - High quality polygonal model. Mesh and details are built by our professional artists.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - Objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

FILE FORMATS:

  - 3ds Max 2018 and Vray 5.0 ( Native format )

  - 3ds Max 2018 Standard materials

  - Maya 2018 Hardware materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 Standard materials

  - Blender 2.91 Eevee materials

  - FBX and OBJ (You can use this format to import them into a lot of different 3D software.)

UV MAPPING AND TEXTURING:

  - PBR textures included: Basecolor, Height, Normal, Roughness, Metallic, Ambient Occlusion, Opacity, Emissive

  - Naming: Textures is named after 3d models to easily manage and quickly search.

  - 4k Resolution: 4096x4096 pixels. Textures are high definition and not blurred.

  - Texture format: PNG

  - Number of texture sets:The number of map sets depends on the actual size of the 3D model. Small size 3D model is a set. Larger 3D models will have more map sets.

  - UVs: Not overlap in UV texture space and maximizes the spacing and fit between them.

HELP AND TIPS:

  - Problem when unzip file: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

  - Smoother faces and edges: You'll need to add subdivision command to get a smoother curved version. ( For example: Turbosmooth in 3ds Max )

  - OBJ and FBX are not smooth: Contact me to get the smoother version for free. Or you can import them into 3D software, add subdivision command and re-export them as high-poly. 

  - Lower version 3D software: Don't worry about lower versions of 3D software. Use FBX or OBJ to import them.

  - For Cinema 4D users: Add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - Don't forget to contact me if you encounter any other issues that aren't listed above.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

FILE FORMATS:

  - 3ds Max 2018 and Vray 5.0 ( Native format )

  - 3ds Max 2018 Standard materials

  - Maya 2018 Hardware materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 Standard materials

  - Blender 2.91 Eevee materials

  - FBX and OBJ (You can use this format to import them into a lot of different 3D software.)

UV MAPPING AND TEXTURING:

  - PBR textures included: Basecolor, Height, Normal, Roughness, Metallic, Ambient Occlusion, Opacity, Emissive

  - Naming: Textures is named after 3d models to easily manage and quickly search.

  - 4k Resolution: 4096x4096 pixels. Textures are high definition and not blurred.

  - Texture format: PNG

  - Number of texture sets:The number of map sets depends on the actual size of the 3D model. Small size 3D model is a set. Larger 3D models will have more map sets.

  - UVs: Not overlap in UV texture space and maximizes the spacing and fit between them.

HELP AND TIPS:

  - Problem when unzip file: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

  - Smoother faces and edges: You'll need to add subdivision command to get a smoother curved version. ( For example: Turbosmooth in 3ds Max )

  - OBJ and FBX are not smooth: Contact me to get the smoother version for free. Or you can import them into 3D software, add subdivision command and re-export them as high-poly. 

  - Lower version 3D software: Don't worry about lower versions of 3D software. Use FBX or OBJ to import them.

  - For Cinema 4D users: Add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - Don't forget to contact me if you encounter any other issues that aren't listed above.

description_text:
Product includes a Ferro Bison Belt, Ferro Single Elastic Pistol, and Ferro Single Elastic ARMags for Single Elastic AR: https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/military/gun/lancer-l5awm-30-round-m4-magazine
The Bison Belt:https://ferroconcepts.com/products/the-bison-belt
Two features not synonymous with the traditional battle belt: lightweight and low profile. We set out to develop a belt constructed with those elements in mind and sacrifice nothing along the way. Designed for and in collaboration with special operations and law enforcement professionals, the Bison belt is the next evolution in battle belt design.
7,278 Tris4k PBR textures
Single Elastic Pistol:https://ferroconcepts.com/collections/accessories/products/single-elastic-pistol
The Single Elastic Pistol is a simple, effective solution for carrying an additional magazine on MOLLE. Taking after our TEAR Front Flap, the SEPs elastic construction allows for various pistol mags or whatever else you can stuff in it. A thermoplastic backer gives rigidity and ample adjustments for mounting the provided shock cord.
2,034 Tris2k PBR textures
Single Elastic AR:https://ferroconcepts.com/collections/accessories/products/single-elastic-ar
The Single Elastic AR is a flexible pouch that allows for a quick, effective way to carry an additional 5.56 AR-15 Magazine. Taking after our TEAR Front Flap, the SEARs elastic construction lends itself well to fitting more than just an AR mag. Flashbangs (tested with CTS Model 7290,) small radios, a TQ, or whatever else you can stuff in there. The thermoplastic backer gives rigidity and the included shock cord allows for adjustable retention.
1,932 Tris2k PBR textures
The belt model might have to be edited to fit your character model.FBX files.Model NOT scaled for printing.Contact me on discord for support.

description_text:
Product name: SHC MC5
This is a car in the ''SHC Moducar'' series, every car in this series uses parts from my ''moducar'' collection wich was in development for several months. This allows me to price the cars according to size/shape/details/options/bumpers instead of asking the same price for every single car. 
 every car in the ''Moducar'' series is brandless, and doesn't need any licencing from real life car companies when using it for commercial purposes like racing games.
Technical specs: 
 -Size: Small Sedan
 -Doors: 4 
 -Engine: V6
 -Sport Pack (wider bodywork, special steering wheel, larger wheels, extra trim levels, larger engine) : Yes 
 -Seats: Normal
 -Roof: Normal 
 -Exhaust: Dual exhaust 
 -Dashboard: tier 3/3 
 -Wheels: tier 2/5
-The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, rigging and modifying. 
 -objects: 50
 -every object in this model has a material channel and an second UVmapped channel optimized for lightmapping, but can also be used for custom texturework or dirt/scratches
-materials and textures without shaders are available in the standard files. 
 -materials and texures with shaders are installed in the unreal engine file, which is used to render the images. (this file is added to this pack for free)
  - every file is exported with the default blender export settings.
File formats: 
 3ds 
 abc 
 blend 
 dae 
 fbx 
 obj 
 ply 
 skp 
 stl 
 x3d

description_text:
Custom designed high detailed brandless car with real cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior
*Detailed engine
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the standard files.
*Materials with shaders are in the included Blender file that is used to create all image renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*Objects: 50
*Every object in this model has a material channel and an second UVmapped channel optimized for lightmapping, but can also be used for custom texturework or dirt/scratches.

description_text:
3d blueprint of the Audi Q2, a german compact SUV, from 2017.
Save precious time in modeling and invest it in personalization, the end result will be what best suits your needs.
It is basically a 3D technical drawing, ready to use in design and architectural projects, or to develop according to your specific needs.
As the texture of the model is the blueprint itself, it allows you to easily add the desired details as well as apply the materials that best fit your purpose.
It’s a low-poly model, on full-scale, and it guarantees the essential forms of the real model without being too faceted.
Hope you enjoy it.José Bronze

description_text:
These cars are rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender files, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this collection is calculated on it's combination of cars relationship to other MCE cars and collections.The lower priced MCE collections have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced collections.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
Thes cars are made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exteriors
*Detailed interiors (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engines (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed undersides
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The cars are linked into several objects to make them more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The cars are royalty free, so you are free to modify and use them in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Average objects per car: 45
*Average polygons: 105.000
*Average verticles: 53.000
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

description_text: The jeep became the primary light wheeled transport vehicle of the United States military and its allies, with President Eisenhower once calling it "one of three decisive weapons the U.S. had during WWII. It was the world's first mass-produced four-wheel drive car; almost 650,000 units were built, constituting a quarter of the total U.S. non-combat motor vehicles produced during the war, and almost two-thirds of the 988,000 light 4WD vehicles produced, counted together with the Dodge WC series. Large numbers of jeeps were provided to U.S. allies, including Soviet Union at the time — aside from large amounts of 11⁄2- and 21⁄2-ton trucks, some 50,000 1⁄4-ton jeeps and 25,000 3⁄4-ton Dodges were shipped to Russia during WWII — more than Nazi Germany's combined total production of their best performing similar vehicles, the Kübelwagen and the amphibious Schwimmwagen.

The Land Rover Evoque is an icon of luxury and versatility, and this high detailed 3D model aims to capture every aspect of its renowned design. With meticulous attention to detail and precision modeling, this model faithfully reproduces the sleek lines, distinctive features, and rugged elegance of the real-life Land Rover Evoque.
Originally introduced in 2011, the Land Rover Evoque represents a bold departure from traditional SUV design, offering a unique blend of style, performance, and capability. Designed to conquer both urban streets and off-road terrain, it features a compact yet muscular silhouette, striking LED headlights, and signature Land Rover grille. The interior is equally impressive, with luxurious materials, cutting-edge technology, and spacious accommodations for passengers.

Two rendering studios are included for VRAY5 with all lightning, materials, background setups

Because different computers have different disks topology, it might be necessary to change the textures patches on the destination computer.

description_text:
The Tesla Model X is an all-electric luxury SUV produced by Tesla, Inc. It was first introduced in 2015 and is known for its distinctive falcon-wing doors, exceptional performance, and advanced electric drivetrain technology. Here are some key features and characteristics of the Tesla Model X:

  - 
Electric Drivetrain:

  - The Model X is an all-electric vehicle, powered by a battery pack that is mounted in the floor of the vehicle. This design contributes to a low center of gravity, enhancing stability and handling.

  - 
Performance:

  - The Model X is available in various configurations with different performance levels. The top-tier versions are known for their impressive acceleration and high top speeds.

  - The Ludicrous Mode, available in certain configurations, enables the Model X to accelerate from 0 to 60 mph in a very short period, showcasing the power and responsiveness of its electric motors.

  - 
Range:

  - Tesla vehicles, including the Model X, are renowned for their long electric range. The range can vary depending on the specific battery configuration, but it generally offers a competitive range compared to other electric vehicles.

  - 
Falcon-Wing Doors:

  - One of the most distinctive features of the Model X is its falcon-wing doors. These upward-hinged rear doors provide easy access to the rear seats and create a unique and futuristic appearance. They are equipped with sensors to ensure they can open in various parking spaces.

  - 
Interior and Seating:

  - The Model X features a sleek and minimalist interior design with a large touchscreen display in the center console, controlling various vehicle functions.

  - Depending on the configuration, the Model X can accommodate up to seven passengers in a three-row seating arrangement.

  - 
Autopilot and Full Self-Driving:

  - Tesla vehicles, including the Model X, come equipped with Autopilot features, which include capabilities such as adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assistance, and automated parking.

  - Full Self-Driving (FSD) capabilities, including automatic lane changes and navigating on certain roads, can be optionally added with a software upgrade.

  - 
Charging:

  - The Model X is compatible with Tesla's Supercharger network, allowing for fast charging at dedicated charging stations. Additionally, it can be charged at home using a standard electrical outlet or a Tesla Wall Connector.

  - 
Safety:

  - The Model X has received high safety ratings and is equipped with advanced safety features, including collision avoidance, automatic emergency braking, and multiple airbags.

Overall, the Tesla Model X combines high-performance electric driving with advanced technology, luxury features, and a unique design, making it a popular choice among electric SUV enthusiasts.

description_text:
This Future Helicopter is a high quality with a Low Polygon model that will enhance detail and realism to your rendering projects. and was originally modeled in Maya 2017 and rendered with Mental Ray   Features:-High quality polygonal model-Low Poly-All colors can be easily modified.-Materials are applied to all polygon and some of them have been unwrapped and textured-All textures and materials are included and mapped in JPEG Format-Only object named Back Wing are textured and unwrapped, other part are applied with material.-Maya 2017 Models models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.-No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.-No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.
-No special plugin needed to open scene.File Formats:

  - Ma

  - Mb

  - OBJ 

  - MTL

  - FBX

Every model has been checked by others Professional Modelers.Warning: Depending on which software you are using, the exchange formats (.obj and .fbx) may not match the preview images exactly. Due to the nature of these formats, there may be some textures that have to be loaded by hand and possibly triangulated geometry.Textures Formats:
- Back_Wing ( JPEG ) 1000 x 1000Hope you like it!
Check out another 3d Model at my account.it will be great and more exclusive day after day.
dicojack

description_text:
A car (or automobile) is a wheeled motor vehicle used for transportation. Most definitions of car say they run primarily on roads, seat one to eight people, have four tires, and mainly transport people rather than goods.[2][3]
Cars came into global use during the 20th century, and developed economies depend on them. The year 1886 is regarded as the birth year of the modern car when German inventor Karl Benz patented his Benz Patent-Motorwagen. Cars became widely available in the early 20th century. One of the first cars accessible to the masses was the 1908 Model T, an American car manufactured by the Ford Motor Company. Cars were rapidly adopted in the US, where they replaced animal-drawn carriages and carts, but took much longer to be accepted in Western Europe and other parts of the world.
Cars have controls for driving, parking, passenger comfort, and a variety of lights. Over the decades, additional features and controls have been added to vehicles, making them progressively more complex. These include rear reversing cameras, air conditioning, navigation systems, and in-car entertainment. Most cars in use in the 2010s are propelled by an internal combustion engine, fueled by the combustion of fossil fuels. Electric cars, which were invented early in the history of the car, began to become commercially available in 2008.
There are costs and benefits to car use. The costs to the individual include acquiring the vehicle, interest payments (if the car is financed), repairs and maintenance, fuel, depreciation, driving time, parking fees, taxes, and insurance.[4] The costs to society include maintaining roads, land use, road congestion, air pollution, public health, health care, and disposing of the vehicle at the end of its life. Road traffic accidents are the largest cause of injury-related deaths worldwide.[5]
The personal benefits include on-demand transportation, mobility, independence, and convenience.[6] The societal benefits include economic benefits, such as job and wealth creation from the automotive industry, transportation provision, societal well-being from leisure and travel opportunities, and revenue generation from the taxes. People's ability to move flexibly from place to place has far-reaching implications for the nature of societies.[7] There are around 1 billion cars in use worldwide. The numbers are increasing rapidly, especially in China, India and other newly industrialized countries

  - AO

  - Height

  - SpecularF0

  - IOR

  - ClearCoatMask

  - ClearCoat Roughness

If you want to change a color of car paint or something else, substance painter scene is provided.

The Cadillac Series 70 (models 70 and 75) is a full-size V8-powered series of cars that were produced by Cadillac from the 1930s to the 1980s. It replaced the 1935 355E as the company's mainstream car just as the much less expensive Series 60 was introduced. The Series 72 and 67 were similar to the Series 75 but the 72 and 67 were produced on a slightly shorter and longer wheelbase respectively. The Series 72 was only produced in 1940 and the Series 67 was only produced in 1941 and 1942. For much of the postwar era, it was the top-of-the-line Cadillac, and was Cadillac's factory-built limousine offering.
Production of the short wheelbase Series 70 ceased in 1938, but reappeared briefly as the relatively expensive Series 70 Eldorado Brougham 4-door hardtop from 1957 to 1958, while the long wheelbase Series 75 made a final appearance in the 1987 model year. description_text:
This model was done with Maya for photorealistic rendering.  The same qality level models are usually sold online on a price around 90 - 130$ so you are getting a product with a good quallity on a very low price.  The exterior is very detailed and suitable for close up views, the interior level of detail looks good at 2+ meters. The geometry has baked vertex colors and vertex normals. Using the vretex colors depends on your workflow and engine requirements but If you use them you are not gonna need much or any ambient oclussion textures. The baked vertex normals ( mostly on the carpaint geo and the tires ) are for accurate reflections, it is important to make sure not to brake them if you want to maitain the same look. The geometry is optimized for use with game engines. As it is here the total polycount is a little over 300k but if you would like to optimize it further, if you bake the front grill and the tires this will reduce it down to 160k triangles.
When you open the scene it should look exactly as on the screenshot 5 above.*Before you open set up Maya vertical axis to Z up - Windows/Settings/Preferences/Settings - World Coordinate System Z*Download both files provided here extract them on your desktop. Place the .MA file in the folder with the textures and keep the textures folder name so that Hypershade can find the textures the first time you open the scene.

description_text:
The Mercedes-Benz 124 series is a range of mid-size cars made by Daimler-Benz from 1984 to 1997. The range included numerous body configurations, and though collectively referred to as the W-124, official internal chassis designations varied by body style: saloon (W 124); estate (S 124): coupé (C 124): cabriolet (A 124): limousine (V 124): rolling chassis (F 124); and long-wheelbase rolling chassis (VF 124).
From 1993, the 124 series was officially marketed as the E-Class. The W 124 followed the 123 series from 1984 and was succeeded by the W 210 E-Class (saloons, estates, rolling chassis) after 1995, and the C 208 CLK-Class (coupés, and cabriolets) in 1997.
In North America, the W124 was launched in early November 1985 as a 1986 model and marketed through the 1995 model year. Series production began at the beginning of November 1984, with press presentation on Monday, 26 November 1984 in Seville, Spain, and customer deliveries and European market launch starting in January 1985.

description_text:
All previews were made in C4DRENDER READY IN ALL FORMATS!
This model has been modeled with a clean topology based on quads and loops.
Animations: -Idle Loop -Walking Loop -Back Walk Loop -Running Loop -Roar Loop
These Animations also have FBX versions already correctly exported, with correct triangulation good for Games!
All High Resolution Textures
There are 2 setups of UVs that you can choose which one to use by any moment:
1- Single UV (Good for Games, or Renders of Mid-Range distance) - This one uses 1 UV with 4K Textures maps. 2- UDIM Setup (Good for Closeup Render) - This one uses multiple UVs (11), so you can get very close to the model and still have details. Here you have 2 UVs with 2K Textures, and 9 UVs with 2K textures.
To change from one setup to another is very easy, it's just by selecting which one of the objects you want to render. They are named properly: Body(singleUV) and Body(UDIM)
Fully Bone Rigged! No vertex MorphTargets are being used. Muscles animations is actually Joint-based Movement, so when exporting everything will be included without problems!
Very easy to animate
The Model is Subdividable
Metric unit used: Centimeters
This pack includes all the following formats:
.c4d (R19/Standard) .c4d .fbx ( FBX Files, with the Animations)

description_text:
ABOUT THE CAR
The Nissan 300ZX is a sports car that was produced across two different generations. As with all other versions of the Z, the 300ZX was sold within the Japanese domestic market under the name Fairlady Z.It was sold in Japan from 1983 to 2000 and in the United States from 1984 to 1996, the 300ZX name followed the numerical convention initiated with the original Z car, the Nissan S30, which was marketed in the U.S. as the 240Z. The addition of the X to the car's name was a carryover from its predecessor, the 280ZX, to signify the presence of more luxury and comfort oriented features. The first generation 300ZX known as the Z31 model was produced from 1983 through 1989 and was a sales success becoming the highest volume Z-car for Nissan. Credit for the information: wikipedia.org
FEATURES

  - Low poly car model: with outline (around 3.8k polygons, 7.6k tris) and without outline (around 1.9k polygons, 3.9k tris);

  - Stylized (toon / cel-shaded);

  - One mesh for chassis, 4 meshes for the wheels, one for the exhaust (double the total when using the outline) and one ground plane acting as a simple cartoon shadow.

WHAT YOU GET WHEN BUYING
When you buy this model, you receive a .zip file containing:

  - 3 different file types (.blend, .fbx and .obj);

  - Hand painted textures (6 textures total, 3 textures with shadow included, 3 textures without shadow included);

  - Included UVs (so you create textures that suit your needs! Before doing so, check the included textures and UV in photoshop to see what does what).

Background for the renders is NOT INCLUDED.
This car model has been made with love and Blender 3.0, and the renders with the Eevee render engine.
Hope you enjoy the model!

description_text:
The Tesla Model S is an electric luxury sedan produced by the American automaker Tesla, Inc. It was first introduced in 2012 and has since become one of the most popular electric vehicles on the market. Here are some key features and specifications of the Tesla Model S:
Design: The Model S has a sleek and aerodynamic design with clean lines and a distinctive front grille. It features a hatchback design, offering ample storage space in the rear trunk and a small front trunk (known as the frunk).
Electric Powertrain: The Model S is powered entirely by electricity, utilizing a battery pack located in the vehicle's floor. The battery capacity and range can vary depending on the specific model and options chosen. Tesla offers different variants with varying levels of performance and range.
Performance: The Model S is known for its impressive acceleration and performance capabilities. The high-end variants, such as the Performance and Plaid models, offer incredibly fast acceleration and top speeds. These models can go from 0 to 60 miles per hour (0 to 97 kilometers per hour) in a matter of seconds.
Range: The range of the Model S can vary depending on the battery capacity and driving conditions. Tesla offers different battery options, with the Long Range versions providing a range of over 300 miles (482 kilometers) on a single charge. The Plaid model offers a slightly lower range due to its higher performance capabilities.
Interior: The Model S has a minimalist interior design with a large touchscreen display in the center console, known as the Tesla's infotainment system. This touchscreen controls various vehicle functions, including media, climate control, and navigation. The interior is spacious and can accommodate up to five passengers, with optional seating configurations available.
Autopilot and Full Self-Driving: Tesla's Model S is equipped with advanced driver-assistance features known as Autopilot. This system allows for semi-autonomous driving, including adaptive cruise control, lane centering, and automated parking. Tesla also offers a Full Self-Driving (FSD) package that promises enhanced autonomous capabilities, although the availability and legal status of FSD features may vary by region.
Charging: The Model S is compatible with Tesla's Supercharger network, which provides high-speed charging capabilities, allowing for quicker charging times on long trips. It is also compatible with other public charging networks and can be charged at home using a standard electrical outlet or a dedicated home charging station.
Overall, the Tesla Model S combines luxurious features, impressive performance, and long electric range, making it a popular choice among electric car enthusiasts.

description_text:
A stepper motor, also known as step motor or stepping motor, is a brushless DC electric motor that divides a full rotation into a number of equal steps. The motor's position can then be commanded to move and hold at one of these steps without any position sensor for feedback (an open-loop controller), as long as the motor is carefully sized to the application in respect to torque and speed.
Switched reluctance motors are very large stepping motors with a reduced pole count, and generally are closed-loop commutated.
Contents1   Fundamentals of operation2   Types3   Two-phase stepper motors3.1 Unipolar motors3.2 Bipolar motors4   Higher-phase count stepper motors5   Driver circuits5.1 L/R driver circuits5.2 Chopper drive circuits6   Phase current waveforms6.1 Wave drive (one phase on)6.2 Full-step drive (two phases on)6.3 Half-stepping6.4 Microstepping7   Theory7.1 Pull-in torque7.2 Pull-out torque7.3 Detent torque7.4 Ringing and resonance8   Ratings and specifications9   Applications10  Stepper motor system11  See also12  References13  External linksFundamentals of operation
A stepper motor
A bipolar hybrid stepper motorBrushed DC motors rotate continuously when DC voltage is applied to their terminals. The stepper motor is known by its property of converting a train of input pulses (typically square wave pulses) into a precisely defined increment in the shaft position. Each pulse moves the shaft through a fixed angle.
Stepper motors effectively have multiple toothed electromagnets arranged around a central gear-shaped piece of iron. The electromagnets are energized by an external driver circuit or a micro controller. To make the motor shaft turn, first, one electromagnet is given power, which magnetically attracts the gear's teeth. When the gear's teeth are aligned to the first electromagnet, they are slightly offset from the next electromagnet. This means that when the next electromagnet is turned on and the first is turned off, the gear rotates slightly to align with the next one. From there the process is repeated. Each of those rotations is called a step, with an integer number of steps making a full rotation. In that way, the motor can be turned by a precise angle.
The circular arrangement of electromagnets is divided into groups, each group called a phase, and there is an equal number of electromagnets per group. The number of groups is chosen by the designer of the stepper motor. The electromagnets of each group are interleaved with the electromagnets of other groups to form a uniform pattern of arrangement. For example, if the stepper motor has two groups identified as A or B, and ten electromagnets in total, then the grouping pattern would be ABABABABAB.
Electromagnets within the same group are all energized together. Because of this, stepper motors with more phases typically have more wires (or leads) to control the motor.
TypesThere are three main types of stepper motors:[1]
Permanent magnet stepperVariable reluctance stepperHybrid synchronous stepperPermanent magnet motors use a permanent magnet (PM) in the rotor and operate on the attraction or repulsion between the rotor PM and the stator electromagnets.
Pulses move the rotor in discrete steps, CW or CCW. If left powered at a final step a strong detent remains at that shaft location. This detent has a predictable spring rate and specified torque limit; slippage occurs if the limit is exceeded. If current is removed a lesser detent still remains, therefore holding shaft position against spring or other torque influences. Stepping can then be resumed while reliably being synchronized with control electronics.
Clarification- Stepper motor detent is analogous to brushless dc motor cogging. In the case of constant speed brushless dc motor, magnetic cogging is of concern for torque ripple effects

A clutch is a mechanical device that engages and disengages power transmission especially from the driving shaft to driven shaft. In the simplest application, clutches connect and disconnect two rotating shafts (drive shafts or line shafts). In these devices, one shaft is typically attached to an engine or other power unit (the driving member) while the other shaft (the driven member) provides output power for work. While typically the motions involved are rotary, linear clutches are also possible.

description_text:
Chopper-style motorcycle.
The word chopper is firmly attached to the appearance of motorcycles with an elongated frame and a front fork.The choppers themselves appeared immediately after the Second World War, when American soldiers who returned home, as is often the case, did not find a place in a peaceful society.​ Accustomed to constant adrenaline during the war, they tried to find it at home, remodeling their Harley Davidson and Indian in garages and driving them. So there was a name for the motorcycle, because chop-means chop, chip in English. Although there are other versions of the name, but this one is considered the most logical. As a result, the chopper is a motorcycle with a powerful engine that has been stripped of everything that has nothing to do with movement. Mirrors, fenders, headlights, bags, rear suspension, front fender and part of the rear, tachometer, large gas tank-all this was abandoned, resulting in a light and elegant motorcycle with a light frame.

Please read the description below before purchasing
This will contain both the files for the low poly version (51,000 vertices) and the high poly version (192,000 vertices) so that they can be used for various types of projects.
Usage recommendations

  - The Low poly version can be used in games and good quality renders, animations, etc.

  - The High poly version can be used in Highly detailed renders, animations, etc.

Please note that the model contains only Quads and no triangles for better topology and Subdivisions so it can be subdivided even higher if needed which may be suitable for close-up renders, etc.

  - FBX File for Low Poly Rim version (No textures)

  - OBJ File for Low Poly Rim version (No textures)

  - Shader Node setup for the brushed material

  - Shader Node setup for the Rim Paintjob

Since the Textures are highly detailed and cannot have PBR textures, the only file extension containing textures is Blend. Although, Shader Node setup has been provided for external uses.

description_text:
This is a model of a Formula 1 car inspired on those of the early 90's. It is made in real life scale and size. Units used for modeling were millimeters, so it might need to be scaled down upon importing into a scene.
The model consists of several, independent pieces, each of them named accordingly. All pieces are monomaterial except for the main body, the steering wheel and the rear lights, which are subdivided in more than one material. Materials do not look exactly like on the renders but are plain colors, however it should be easy to configure them. The renders were made just dropping standard materials from the Keyshot library onto the model, the file used for rendering is also included. The last 4 previews feature how the model looks like on SolidWorks and 3DS Max viewports, 2 apiece. Max, fbx and obj+mtl files are mesh files with roughly 107000 triangles.
Hope you like it, feel free to ask or suggest anything!

description_text:
This is a 3D model of the Tamiya TT-01 RC Car. The scale is 1:10 and is highly detailed with all parts and special modifications such as a cooling fan on top of the CPR unit. This allows you to use a more powerful engine without risking to overheat, because the battery provides the power over the receiver to the engine and not directly. I modelled all parts myself!
The bodywork is also included in the package! As you can see the bodywork fits on top. You can add your own bodywork on top of the Tamiya TT-01. Keep in mind that the plug positioning needs to be compatible. However, this is a regular positioning that should work for the most bodyworks. I tested couple of bodyworks with it myself and it worked so far.
You can try to print it but keep in mind that it has been made as a 3D model with the intention to show the part construction. So if you print, some parts could differ little bit from original or some may not fit perfectly. The unit is in mm.
The 3dm is uploaded as Rhino 5. This allows all users to still open it and new rhino users can still open it even with Rhino 7. I also added other file types such as .Obj, .3ds and more
If you have questions or issues with the model, feel free to contact me and I am looking forward to help you out.
The Tamiya TT-01 is a popular chassis under the RC Car racing scene due its clear structure and effective performance.
This model has been made by myself and is primarily for the private use. I don't allow you to sell this model under your own or even my name or to claim that you have done it!
If you buy this, please follow these arrangements above!

The first-generation Chevrolet Camaro is an American pony car introduced by Chevrolet in the fall of 1966 for the 1967 model year. It rode on a brand-new rear wheel drive GM F-body platform and was available as a 2-door, 2+2 seat, hardtop, and convertible. The F-body was shared with the Pontiac Firebird for all generations. A 230 cu in Chevrolet straight-6 was standard, with several Chevy V8s available as options. The first-generation Camaro was built through the 1969 model year.
Almost all of 1967–1969 Camaros were built in the two U.S. assembly plants: Norwood, Ohio and Van Nuys, California. description_text:
High detailed model of a New Jersey Road Barrier with Road Delineators.
Originally created with 3ds Max 2009. 
This model is suitable for use in high-res film close-ups, advertising, animations, day and night scenes with light effects. 

- 46 separate objects organized in 1 Group
- All the objects are properly named separately.
- 1 Camera and 1 Sky Light.
- 6237 polygons, 7437 vertices (without smooth modifiers).
- All preview images are rendered with Mental Ray Renderer 
- Product is ready to render out-of-the-box.
- Lights and cameras are included in the file. 
- All Mental Ray materials included.
The material of Road Delineators has been created to simulate the real effect of delineators.
The light is reflected towards the light source and the flash of light is perceived also in the surrounding area of the light source just like a real road delineator.

- All the textures are included in MAX archive.
- Model is built to real-world scale 
- Units used: Centimeters.
- Model is 200x60x90 centimeters (LxWxH). 
- No third-party renderer or plug-ins needed

What's Inside:▲ over 36 unique objects ▲ 1 custom map ▲ 20+ example scenes ▲ Models inside: motorbike, truck, van, small car, trees, car wheel, boiler building, chimney, clif, electricity, bridge, fence, fence pillar, foliage bush, foliage tree, line, ladder, mountains, tire, sign, stone, bus, water tank, box, crocodile, character, energy line, flower, house, palette, street light, ▲ allows to quickly create good looking city environments▲ FBX, OBJ, 3DS, MAX, Textures formats Included▲ Rendered using Octane Render & Unity3D▲ UnityPackage with 3 Example Scenes
Features:▲ active development & support▲ easy to use for beginners and professionals▲ clean hierarchy & correct size▲ each element has been carefully crafted, with in-game use optimization in mind.
Technical aspects:▲ prebaked textures (for AO & better optimization)▲ correct proportions▲ triangles count starting from 20-2000 triangles▲ each model UV mapped (no overlapping UV's)▲ separated vehicles parts for steering
Cheers,beffio team

description_text:
Dacia Front Badge Collection. Contains 4 Dacia emblems from 1968 till 2008. The latest one is the only one missing from the collection. STL files are available if you want to 3d print them. As a bonus, a UAP pin badge is included in this collection. That one is very rare and very old.

description_text:
Immerse yourself in the world of classical antiquity with this meticulously crafted Greek Warrior Stela relief. It is professionally optimized for high-resolution 3D printing and precision CNC machining.
Key Features:
Historical Authenticity: Digitally sculpted to capture the artistic style of Greek steles, featuring detailed armor, muscular definition, and realistic stone textures.
Production Ready: Perfect for Resin (SLA/DLP) printers to preserve fine details, as well as Filament (FDM) printers and CNC routers for wood or stone engraving.
Versatile Decor: An exceptional choice for museum-style home galleries, office decor, or as a high-end gift for history enthusiasts.
Scalable Geometry: The high-poly STL file allows for easy resizing from small desk ornaments to large-scale wall installations without losing detail.
Technical Specifications:
File Format: High-resolution STL.
Model Size: 434x928x62 mm
Historical Period: Classical Greece / Hellenistic Art.
Compatibility: Ready for use with all major slicers and CNC software like ArtCAM and Aspire.
Ideal Use Cases:
Historical Collections: A must-have for collectors of ancient military and archaeological replicas.
Interior Design: Adds a noble and scholarly atmosphere to libraries, studies, or living spaces.
Educational Purpose: Ideal for classrooms, museums, or historical dioramas.

description_text:
Villa Horizontal – Modern Villa 3D Model | SketchUp + Lumion + Blender Full Architectural Package
Modern minimalist villa 3D model — a complete, render-ready architectural visualization package covering the full preliminary design stage: textured SketchUp 3D model, coordinated 2D CAD drawings, Lumion exterior/interior render scenes (day & night lighting), and 10 post-production PSD files.
Built for architects, students, and 3D visualization artists to reuse AND learn from: explore how materials, textures, cameras, and balanced natural lighting are set up in a professional archviz workflow. Speed up your concept design & preliminary design process and win more project approvals.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
1. 3D Model (Native SketchUp)

  - SketchUp .skp (2013+) — clean, organized groups & components

  - Exports: FBX / OBJ / 3DS / DAE / MTL / Blender-ready (SketchUp default export settings; grass, car, canvas art & pool water not exported)

  - Separate Lumion-ready files included

2. Architecture 2D Drawings

  - SketchUp LayOut (.layout): floor plans & elevations, coordinated with the 3D model

  - PDF set

  - Imperial title blocks, landscape: Arch D (36×24) + Arch D cover sheet

3. Lumion Render Scene (Lumion 10+)

  - Full scene in .ls10 format — trees, grass, furniture, pool

  - 29 textures, complete light setup

  - 10 camera settings

  - 2 natural lighting presets: daylight & evening/night

4. Post-Production
  - 10 final PSD files with adjustment layers — study the complete post-production workflow
TECHNICAL SPECS

  - SketchUp: 1,217 groups | 428 instances | 876,369 faces | 11 cameras | 50 materials | 29 textures

  - FBX/OBJ: 908,547 faces | 49 materials | 29 textures

  - 3DS: 1,156,327 triangles | 11 cameras | 50 materials

  - Created with SketchUp 2013 & Lumion 10

NO PROTECTION / FULLY EDITABLE — reuse the scene, lights, materials and render settings freely, or dive inside the file to learn how professional lighting and material development is done.
